entities.summary: Noor-Ali Tabandeh was the spiritual leader or Qutb of the Ni'matullah Gonabadi Order in Iran, which is the largest Sufi order in Iran. He was born in Beydokht, Gonabad, Iran and died in Mehr Hospital in Tehran on 24 December 2019 after two years of house arrest.
